title: Blur XX AXS Race FA RSV
body_html:
The new Blur is made for trails, whether you’re racing for podiums or hammering into the sunrise. The suspension, geometry, and chassis combine to deliver a platform capable of the top step—the rest is up to you.
We bumped up the travel, updated the geometry, and spent a lot of time tweaking the suspension kinematics to encourage you to obliterate the boundaries of a traditional “XC bike.” The Blur is right at home sprinting for the hole shot, but it’s also a lightweight and immensely capable short-travel trail bike for the days between the races. Whether you're sprinting out of the gate or out of a corner, aiming for the horizon or the apex, the Blur takes XCO and injects some 'oh, hell yeah!' into every ride, Monday through Sunday.

body_html: The Tallboy is a short-travel bike with long legs. Our perennial 29-inch bike has gone on a diet and bulked up the amount of travel to fit the kind of rider looking to maximize power hours or just ride all the hours. It’s light and efficient enough to climb with the best of them, yet punches way above its weight class as soon as the trail turns down. Excellent suspension, big wheels, thoroughly-tuned carbon layup and rock-solid reliability let you go as hard as you want.

title: Stigmata Frame
body_html: The Stigmata blurs the lines between free-roading drop bar singletrack slicer and buckled down race-winning gravel machine. It’s designed for the rider lining up for The Big Event, escaping via the road less traveled or who can’t help themselves from finding the hardest way there. Whether your style is baggy or zipped up, the Stigmata is the fast and loose riding partner that’s always ready to rise to the occasion.

title: Nomad Deore
body_html: Zip it into the bag, chuck it in the van, or toss it over the tailgate—when you get to the trails, you’ll be happy you’re on a Nomad. In short, you’ll be more comfortable, more composed, and more confident no matter what the trail throws your way.

title: Campout Bottle 32oz Smoke
body_html:
Nalgene bottles are now made with a revolutionary resin powered by new
recycling technology that transforms plastic destined for landfills into high-performance
BPA/BPS-free bottles. This material is derived from 50% waste
plastic (using ISCC certified mass balance), further offsetting the use of fossil
fuels and lowering greenhouse gas emissions.

title: Down Time Merino Sock
body_html: An ultra-comfy merino-blend sock that fits any occasion, whether you're around a campfire, on your local flow, or lapping the office to get your steps in. We think that good socks shouldn't be overlooked, and with three retro ringer colorways you'll have a hard time not admiring them while you're staring at your feet, wishing you were riding.

title: Lunch Ride Sock
body_html: At Santa Cruz, we sweat the details. Even if those details are ensuring your socks match your favorite bike when you decide to empty the tank on your lunch ride. With a generous cuff to keep the tan lines sharp, and a durable nylon-poly blend, you can ride easy knowing you won't poke holes in the toes trying to out-sprint the guy from Finance.

title: Women's Framed Tee
body_html: Sometimes coming up with a good graphic for our tees is difficult, but sometimes we realize the art is rolling across the production floor every hour here at Santa Cruz HQ. We've taken our greatest hits and slapped em on the back of the Framed Tee, and complimented them with a graphic package we were legally advised might be "too cool". We think there's no such thing.

title: Women's Threaded Crewneck
body_html: There's just something about a good crewneck sweater that feels like home. Cozy and classy at the same time, with a premium embroidery and relaxed drop-shoulder fit. We spent a lot of time on this one, making sure you'd feel comfortable wearing it for all your pre-coffee foggy mornings, and post-dinner porch hangs.

title: Women's Blur Squared Tank
body_html: We swear it's not a misprint, we just wanted to make sure anyone wearing this tank looked really fast. With design cues from our Blur Squared Tee, this tank rounds out any wardrobe with a comfy cut and soft cotton construction. Whether you're just trying to stay cool, or show off all the time you've been spending on the weight rack, this one's for you.

title: Women's Blur Squared Crop
body_html: We swear it's not a misprint, we just wanted to make sure anyone wearing this tank looked really fast. Taking some notes from our Blur Squared Tee, this trackside crop will keep you cool and comfortable all day. Equally at home on steep trail descents, buttery gravel roads, or at your favorite coffee shop stop.

title: Threaded Crewneck
body_html:
If you were going to wear a sweatshirt on a date, it would probably be
this one. The embroidery makes it that much classier. Careful, though,
sweatshirts this soft and comfortable have a way of becoming not-yours after a few dates.

  • Relaxed fit, drop shoulder
  • Mid weight
  • 80% cotton 20% recycled polyester

title: Frasca Cap
body_html: Have you ever had that one friend that always wears the same hat? That's pretty much everyone over here at Santa Cruz, so we thought we'd add a fresh one to everyone's repertoire. Tailored for our friends in colder weather and those interested in giving off a real 80s ski vibe, we've embroidered our logo onto some supremely comfy corduroy to keep your dome covered in all conditions.

title: Squared Up Women's Tee
body_html: When the fall lines are steep and the catch berms are small, you know what to do. Square up. This variation of our classic squared tee isn't afraid to boldly rep Santa Cruz wherever it goes. Available in colors ranging mild to wild. Now in a women's specific fit.

title: Faded Tee
body_html: Inspired by the double vision you get when looking down a row of Santa Cruz downtubes in the back of a shuttle rig, the Faded Tee ensures your brand affiliation won't go unnoticed. Casual, classic, and designed to last. If you're looking for a staple tee with a little bit of flash, this one's for you.

title: Squared Crew
body_html:
We try not to pick favorites on what we've created here at Santa Cruz, but hard not to have this as a single go-to midweight layer when temps dip into sweater weather. This is workwear inspired, but the Cotton French Terry is comfortable and cozy. We won't blame you if this is your new preferred sweatshirt either.

• Relaxed Fit
• 80% cotton 20% recycled polyester

title: EDC Plug Plier Kit
body_html:
The EDC PLUG & PLIERS KIT is the perfect addition to the EDC tool system. The tire plug Jabber Tool threads directly into the EDC carrier (SOLD SEPARATELY).. The new Quick Link Breaker Pliers are compatible with all 10,11, and 12 speed quick links chains. Both new tools and bacon strips store perfectly within the EDC capsule ready for race day deployment.

KIT INCLUDES

  • Quick Link Breaker Pliers (10, 11, 12SP)
  • Tire Plug Jabber Tool
  • 15 - Bacon Strips

SPEC

Material: aluminum/steel/bacon

Weight: 17g all in

Compatible with: EDC TOOL SYSTEM

Colors: GREEN

title: EDC Tap Kit
body_html:
TAPPING INSTRUCTIONS
Remove your old star-nut and tap the top of your steerer tube. This might sound daunting, but we've made it super easy to do on your bike, without even removing your fork.
* Remove your bar and stem
* Use the OneUp star-nut puller to remove your old star nut
* Using the self aligning steerer tap kit, tap a thread into your steerer until the tap bottoms out.

The OneUp EDC Tap Kit includes: A Star Nut Puller / "Go No-Go" Gauge,Tap and Tap Guide. (A Tap is a common cutting tool used to manufacture/cut internal threads)

title: EDC Top Cap
body_html:
The EDC Cap Kit includes the worlds lightest headset top cap (4.2g), and an EDC steerer plug with drain hole which keeps crud out of your steerer.
Top caps are compatible with all 1-1/8" aluminum steerer tubes.
The EDC steerer plug is required for EDC tool storage and is compatible with most aluminum tapered steerer tubes.
Check fork compatibility.

KIT INCLUDES
* EDC TOP CAP
* EDC steerer plug
* 2x 1mm, 3mm, & 5mm Headset Spacers
